type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Add Protocol-Vessel-Control README and Human Rights framework
Complete Act I repository structure: manifesto, proofs, scripts, Olympic mapping, legal docs

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: capacity_from_proof
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h : Human) (p : FormalProof) (h_produces : produces h p) (h_verifiable : verifiable p) (h_complex : complex p) : capable h

theorems_only_on_branches.name: cryptographic_evidence_precedence
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (e_sensor e_crypto : Evidence),   (match e_sensor, e_crypto with     | Evidence.measurement value protocol, Evidence.git_commit hash timestamp => True     | x, x_1 => False) →     ∃ precedence, precedence

theorems_only_on_branches.name: impossibility_lemma
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h : Human) (m : Measurement) (p : FormalProof) (h_measurement_says_incapable : indicates_incapacity m) (h_proof_says_capable : produces h p ∧ verifiable p ∧ complex p) (h_concurrent : p.timestamp = m.timestamp) : ¬(¬capable h ∧ capable h)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: measurement_error
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h : Human) (m : Measurement) (p : FormalProof) (h_capable : capable h) (h_measurement : indicates_incapacity m) (h_produces : produces h p) (h_verifiable : verifiable p) (h_complex : complex p) (h_concurrent : p.timestamp = m.timestamp) : ∃ (error : Prop), error

theorems_only_on_branches.name: measurement_must_be_false
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (h : Human) (m : Measurement) (p : FormalProof) (h_proof_verified : verifiable p ∧ complex p ∧ produces h p) (h_measurement_claims : indicates_incapacity m) (h_concurrent : p.timestamp = m.timestamp) : ∃ (protocol_error : Prop), protocol_error

theorems_only_on_branches.name: protocol_systematic_flaw
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: Protocol →   (∀ (acetone ethanol : Float), acetone > 0 → ethanol = 0 → ∃ false_positive, false_positive) →     ∃ design_flaw, design_flaw

theorems_only_on_branches.name: self_proving
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∃ proof,   match proof with   | Evidence.formal_proof verified complexity => verified = true   | x => False
